title: Scene specs
description: Structure of stages/04_design/output/scene-specs.yaml: layout, entry, and the actions of each reveal step, in the motion vocabulary of _config/build-rules.md. Read by scripts/build-site.mjs.

text_reveal.description: One reveal behaviour for on-screen lines across the explainer: per-step (line n has its own show-text step, in order) or with-scene (every line visible from step 0, no show-text)

kind.description: assemble: the title scene only, with title art: the boundary, then the parts, then the lines

from_view.description: zoom-in / zoom-out: the view the zoom starts from

target.description: zoom-in / zoom-out: the function that expands or collapses

targets.description: Element, relationship, or step IDs ('step-3'); text line indexes ('text-1'); for expand and collapse, element IDs with what_it_does

state.description: do: state - a named state from the view spec

title_visual.description: The title scene only: the picture beside the solution's name (iteration 003, D4)

kind.description: art: drawn from the model's structure; image: an approved, licensed image in title/

from_view.description: art: the wired L1 or L2 view whose level the art draws (default: the first wired L2 view)

image.description: image: a file name in stages/04_design/output/title/

alt.description: image: what the image shows, for screen readers

end_state.description: What the screen shows after the last step, in words
